message:
Accented letters now survive in blog slugs: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including the previously failing one.

The fix is one line in `src/blog/slug.js`. The vendored `slugify` silently drops any non-ASCII character, so I decompose the title to NFD first, which splits each accent into a base letter plus a combining mark, then strip the marks before slugging. I didn't touch `vendor/`.

The same accent-dropping would affect `src/shop/product-url.js`, which also uses `slugify`. I left it unchanged since you asked for the blog fix only. Say if you want the same treatment there.
